audience: small businesses in Turkey that track receivables, payables and collections in Kobiyi

useCases.title: List overdue receivables by customer
useCases.text: List the receivables with status, contact and due-date filters. Open a contact to see its overdue amount and credit risk.

useCases.title: Check unmatched bank transactions
useCases.text: List the bank transactions with their match status, and the cash accounts they belong to.

useCases.title: Record a customer payment
useCases.text: Record money received against a receivable. Use a new idempotency key for each payment, and reuse it only to retry the same payment.

useCases.title: Add a receivable with an installment plan
useCases.text: Create a receivable for a contact, with an amount and an optional installment plan. With an external id, a repeated call returns the existing record.

useCases.title: Review cheques by due date
useCases.text: List the received and given cheques with their status and due date.
